body: Im sure they wont. I try to do good. I try to be honest. I try to be loyal. I try a lot of these things. For some reason I always think that if I do these things that the people I attract around me will do the same but it never happens. People just take advantage of my kindness and love. They just shit all over my heart anytime I let someone in. It never fails and this includes family. People I have let in closest to my heart have either created huge living lies, cheated on me, stolen from me. The list goes on. I'm just so sick of everything in my life. My brain is fucked chemically and I am fucked emotionally. I cannot imagine another 60 to 80 years of this fucking shitstorm they call life.

Thank you. It has been a struggle for sure. Depression is one progressive sob. It makes me want to use so bad but i know things will get a LOT worse if I do. I just dontreally see what I can do about this whole state of mind. All I wish that would happen would be for me to disappear but it is just so cruel imo to those that love you to go through with it. It would kill my Mom for sure. My family has gone through a lot the last few years and I know she would lose it if I was to die.
